narrative.northStar: La Feuille de Blanmont — Carte IGN
narrative.overview:
The CC Saint-Martin Blanmont visual system is printed like a topographic sheet of the club's real territory around the Place de la Féchère (5m contours, Dyle rivers, railway, secondary roads, Bois de Buis). The website is not a generic SaaS dashboard, but a tactile, cartographic document of Flemish & Walloon Brabant cycling routes.

The light sheet rests on creamy topographic map paper (#fbfbf8) with black Archivo lettering and official map spot inks (route red, relief bistre, hydro blue, woodland green, and amber). The night sheet inverts onto deep nocturnal inks (#0d1013) with crisp snow lettering (#eef1f4). Structure is established through precision neatlines (border-line / border-night-line), corner ticks, geodetic marks, and printed cartouches.
keyCharacteristics: Topographic Sheet Cartouche: Every major page opens on a band of the club's territory with a printed cartouche header (SheetHeader), coordinates, and key facts legend.
Archivo Superfamily Hierarchy: Variable font Archivo carrying hierarchy through font width (font-wide, font-semiwide, font-narrow) rather than oversized tracked type.
Spot Inks: Map colors are semantic spot inks: Route Red (#d63535), Relief Bistre (#b0703b), Hydro Blue (#1f6fbf), Woodland Green (#2e7d45), and Amber (#e8962a).
Flat-by-Default & Hairline Precision: 1px hairline rules (border-line / border-night-line), crisp 2–6px sheet corners, corner ticks, and zero artificial blur/shadow unless elevated.
Geodetic Point & Telemetry: Departure point at Place de la Féchère (50°37′23″ N · 4°38′32″ E) printed with the geodetic mark (GeodeticMark), tabular figures (tabular-nums) for all metrics.

rules.name: The Map Spot Ink Rule
rules.body: Colors represent physical geography and status (Route Red, Relief Bistre, Hydro Blue, Woodland Green, Amber). Never introduce decorative gradients, arbitrary pastels, or SaaS blues.

rules.name: The Ground Contrast Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are strictly authentic map paper (#fbfbf8) or nocturnal sheet (#0d1013), divided by neatlines. Never introduce muddy mid-tone grays.

rules.name: The Full-Strength Brand Accent Rule
rules.body: Brand red (#d63535) is reserved strictly for action triggers, active tabs, live dots, and primary CTAs. It is never used as a diffuse wash over large containers.

rules.name: The Width-Over-Tracking Rule
rules.body: Express typographic hierarchy through Archivo's variable font width (font-wide for display, font-semiwide for headlines, font-narrow for labels) rather than artificially stretched letter-spacing.

rules.name: The Tabular Metric Rule
rules.body: Every cycling metric (km, m D+, km/h, time splits) must use tabular-nums with explicit units.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Do not stack ornamental uppercase kickers above major headlines; let the cartouche and scale bar speak.

rules.name: The Cartouche Sheet Rule
rules.body: Every major section or page opens with a cartouche neatline banner (SheetHeader) stating coordinates and territory facts.

rules.name: The Asymmetric Spread Rule
rules.body: Never compose pages from monotonous rows of identical cards; vary cell spans, topographic previews, and tabular blocks to construct an authentic cartographic sheet.

rules.name: The Neatline Depth Rule
rules.body: A 1px crisp neatline rule conveys precision boundaries faster and cleaner than a soft blur.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest completely flat against their ground; elevation occurs solely in response to interactive states (hover, focus, modal dialog).

rules.name: The Sheet Corner Rule
rules.body: Interactive containers and cards use crisp 3px–6px radii reminiscent of printed card sheets; full pill radii are reserved strictly for status chips and badges.

rules.name: The Corner Tick Rule
rules.body: Hero containers and callout boxes use subtle corner tick marks (corner-ticks) evoking survey sheet framing.

dos: Do write all user-facing copy in idiomatic French (e.g. 'Parcours', 'Sortie du Samedi', 'Dénivelé', 'Télécharger GPX').
Do use semantic Tailwind tokens (bg-paper, text-ink, border-line, bg-night, text-snow, bg-brand).
Do use SheetHeader for page headers across the public site.
Do format cycling metrics with tabular-nums and appropriate French non-breaking spacing (85 km, 720 m D+).
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion for all map animations and canvas wind fields.
Do use 1px hairlines and corner ticks to frame cartographic surfaces.
donts: Don't use hardcoded hex utilities (#101216, #faf8f5, #0a0c10) — always use semantic theme tokens.
Don't use decorative glassmorphism, blur halos, or gratuitous gradients.
Don't use Poppins or arbitrary Google fonts — Archivo is the superfamily.
Don't use naive UTC date parsing that causes date shifts across timezones.
Don't use full pill radii on buttons; reserve pills strictly for status indicators.
